content: अञ्जनः .²1 A kind of lizard. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a tree or mountain. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of the guardian elephant (of the west or <ab>s. w.</ab>) तस्य चान्येऽपि दिङ्नागा बभूवुरनुयायिनः . अञ्जनो वामनश्चैव महापद्मश्च सुप्रभः .. <ls>Mb. 6. 64. 57</ls>. .{@-नम्@} [अज्यते अनेन; अञ्ज् ल्युट्] .²1 Anointing, smearing with, दन्तधावनमञ्जनं पूर्वाह्व एव कुर्वीत <ls>Ms. 4. 152</ls>; mixing; unfolding, manifesting. .²2 Collyrium or black pigment used to paint the eyelashes; विलोचनं दक्षिणमञ्जनेन संभाव्य <ls>R. 7. 8</ls> salve; अमृत ˚कोऽयं दृशोरमृताञ्जनम् <ls>U. 4. 18</ls> ambrosial salve; कुर्वन् ˚मेचका इव दिशो मेघः समुत्तिष्ठते <ls>Mk. 5. 8</ls>, <ls n="Mk.">1. 34</ls>; (<ab>fig.</ab> also) अज्ञानान्धस्य लोकस्य ज्ञानाञ्जनशलाकया . चक्षुरुन्मीलितं येन तस्मै पाणिनये नमः .. <ls>Śik. 45</ls>; पटुतरविवेकाञ्जनजुषाम् <ls>Bh. 3. 84</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> also दारिद्र्यं परमाञ्जनम्; (<ab>fig.</ab>) impurity, as in निरञ्जन, <ab>q. v.</ab> .²3 Paint, a cosmetic ointment. .²4 Magic ointment. .²5 A special kind of material of the black pigment, such as antimony (used as collyrium, lamp-black <ab>&c.</ab>) (सौवीर). .²6 Ink. .²7 Fire. .²8 Night. .²9 (नम्, ना) (<ab>Rhet.</ab>) A suggested meaning; also the process by which such meaning is suggested. It is the power of suggestion (founded on अभिधा or लक्षणा denotation or indication), by which something else is understood from a word which, though having more meanings than one, has been restricted to a single meaning by relations of conjunction, disjunction <ab>&c.</ab> (संयोग, विप्रयोग, साहचर्य, विरोधिता <ab>&c.</ab>), or, briefly, the use of a word of several meanings in a special sense determined by the context; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} सशङ्घचक्रो हरिः the adjective restricts Hari to mean ‘Viṣṇu’ alone, and not a ‘lion’ or ‘monkey’; so रामलक्ष्मणौ दाशरथी, रामार्जुनौ भार्गवकार्तवीर्यौ <ab>&c.</ab>; <ab>cf.</ab> अनेकार्थस्य शब्दस्य वाचकत्वे नियन्त्रिते . संयोगाद्यैरवाच्यार्थधीकृद् व्यापृतिरञ्जनम् .. <ls>K. P. 2.</ls>; <ls>S. D. 23-6</ls>; See व्यञ्जना also.
